kernel.governing_law: A cyclic cosmological-juridical grammar: force bites through obstruction to make clarity, clarity adorns but cannot judge, adornment stripped to ground, and from ground the first motion returns — the sovereign reads each phase as instruction for wielding or withholding power.
kernel.mutated_relation: The conditions each utterance requires in order to be utterable: the obstruction that must already exist for biting to be named, the insufficiency that must already be felt for adornment to be prescribed, the height that must already stand for stripping to proceed, the absence that must already be total for return to mean anything — each phase spoken from inside the prior phase's unspeakable interior.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
100101
噬嗑 火雷噬嗑 离上震下
噬嗑：亨，利用狱。
译文：《噬嗑卦》；象征咬合：障碍已横于口中，故咬合方可命名；亨通无阻，有利于使用刑法
象曰：雷电，噬嗑；先王以明罚敕法。
译文：《象辞》说：《噬嗑卦》的卦象是震(雷)下离(火)上，为雷电交击之表象。障碍物已先在齿间，咬合之名方从其内而出；雷有威慑力，电能放光明，古代帝王效法这一现象，明其刑法，正其法令
101001
贲 山火贲 艮上离下
贲：亨，小利，有攸往。
译文：《贲卦》象征装饰：不足已先被感知，故装饰方可施用；亨通，利于柔小者前去行事
象曰：山下有火，贲；君子以明庶政，无敢折狱。
译文：《象辞》说：《贲卦》的卦象是离(火)下艮(山)上，为山下燃烧着火焰之表象。不足已先在素面之中，装饰之令方从其内而发；君子像火焰一样，使众多的政务清明，但却不能用修饰的方法来断官司
000001
剥 山地剥 艮上坤下
剥：不利有攸往。
译文：《剥卦》象征剥落：高度已先矗立在上，故剥落方可进行；不利于前去行事
象曰：山附于地，剥；上以厚下安宅。
译文：《象辞》说：《剥卦》的卦象是坤(地)下艮(山)上，好比高山受侵蚀而风化，逐渐接近于地面之表象，因而象征剥落；高度已先立于顶端，剥落之行方从其内而下；位居在上的人看到这一现象，应当加强基础，使它更加厚实，只有这样才能巩固其住所而不至发生危险
100000
复 地雷复 坤上震下
复：亨。出入无疾，朋来无咎。反复其道，七日来复。利有攸往。
译文：《复卦》象征复归：缺失已先彻底完成，故复归方有所指；亨通顺利。阳气从下面产生而逐渐向上行进没有阻碍，朋友前来也没有灾难危害。返回复归有一定的运动规律，经过七天就会前来复归。利于前去行事
象曰：雷在地中，复；先王以至日闭关，商旅不行，后不省方。
译文：《象辞》说：《复卦》的卦象是震(雷)下坤(地)上，为雷在地中、阳气微弱地活动之表象，因而象征复归；缺失已先尽于寂灭之内，复归之义方从其内而生；从前的君主在阳气初生的冬至这一天关闭关口，使商人旅客停止活动，不外出经商、旅行，君主自己也不巡行视察四方
artifacts.enantiomorph_translation:
100101
噬嗑 Fire-Thunder噬嗑 Li above Zhen below
噬嗑: Prosperous; beneficial to employ punishments.
Image says: Thunder and lightning,噬嗑; the former kings used this to clarify penalties and rectify laws.

101001
贲 Mountain-Fire 贲 Gen above Li below
贲: Prosperous; small benefit; there is somewhere to go.
Image says: Below the mountain there is fire, 贲; the noble man uses this to illuminate the multitude of affairs of governance, but does not dare to decide lawsuits.

000001
剥 Mountain-Earth 剥 Gen above Kun below
剥: Not beneficial to have somewhere to go.
Image says: The mountain clings to the earth, 剥; those above use this to strengthen what is below and secure their dwelling.

100000
复 Earth-Thunder 复 Kun above Zhen below
复: Prosperous. Going out and coming in without ailment; friends coming, no blame. Returning and repeating its way; after seven days it comes back. Beneficial to have somewhere to go.
Image says: Thunder is within the earth, 复; the former kings, at the solstice day, closed the passes; merchants and travelers did not travel; the ruler did not inspect the regions.

independent.recovered_law: In TEXT B, each hexagram's interpretation is augmented with an explicit causal prerequisite: the condition that the hexagram names must already exist prior to the action (e.g., 'obstacle already present, therefore biting applies'; 'deficiency already perceived, therefore adornment applies'). TEXT A treats each hexagram symbol as a direct description without this 'X must precede Y for Y to be named' logical dependency.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural change: TEXT B introduces explicit causal prerequisites — each action/phase requires a prior condition to already exist before it can be named or applied, whereas TEXT A treats descriptions directly without this logical dependency.
independent.terminal_note: The final hexagram (复/Return) in TEXT B maintains the same inserted prerequisite pattern ('缺失已先彻底完成，故复归方有所指') consistent with the changed relation throughout.
